+"""Directed soft assignment matching with soft-centroid separation."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+
+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    weight = parameters.get("weight", 0.005)
+    tau = parameters.get("tau", 0.1)
+    tau_pair = parameters.get("tau_pair", 0.1)
+    eps = parameters.get("eps", 1e-8)
+    repulsion = parameters.get("repulsion", 1.0)
+    sep_min = parameters.get("sep_min", 0.2)
+    # Separate source and target assignment distributions. The source-conditioned
+    # q logits preserve direction (unlike a symmetric pair-product alone).
+    ps = F.softmax(-torch.cdist(source, codebook).square() / tau, dim=-1)
+    pt = F.softmax(-torch.cdist(target, codebook).square() / tau, dim=-1)
+    q = F.softmax((ps * pt + ps) / tau_pair, dim=-1)
+    joint = (q * ps * pt).sum(dim=-1)
+    ms, mt = ps @ codebook, pt @ codebook
+    separation = F.relu(sep_min - torch.linalg.vector_norm(ms - mt, dim=-1)).square()
+    per_pair = -torch.log(joint + eps) + repulsion * separation
+    mask = mask.to(dtype=per_pair.dtype, device=per_pair.device)
+    denom = mask.sum()
+    if denom.item() == 0:
+        return per_pair.sum() * 0.0
+    return weight * (per_pair * mask).sum() / denom

+"""Directed soft assignment matching with soft-centroid separation."""

+import torch.nn.functional as F
+

+def mechanism_loss(source, target, codebook, mask, **parameters):
+    weight = parameters.get("weight", 0.005)
+    tau = parameters.get("tau", 0.1)
+    tau_pair = parameters.get("tau_pair", 0.1)
+    eps = parameters.get("eps", 1e-8)
+    repulsion = parameters.get("repulsion", 1.0)
+    sep_min = parameters.get("sep_min", 0.2)
+    # Separate source and target assignment distributions. The source-conditioned
+    # q logits preserve direction (unlike a symmetric pair-product alone).
+    ps = F.softmax(-torch.cdist(source, codebook).square() / tau, dim=-1)
+    pt = F.softmax(-torch.cdist(target, codebook).square() / tau, dim=-1)
+    q = F.softmax((ps * pt + ps) / tau_pair, dim=-1)
+    joint = (q * ps * pt).sum(dim=-1)
+    ms, mt = ps @ codebook, pt @ codebook
+    separation = F.relu(sep_min - torch.linalg.vector_norm(ms - mt, dim=-1)).square()
+    per_pair = -torch.log(joint + eps) + repulsion * separation
+    mask = mask.to(dtype=per_pair.dtype, device=per_pair.device)
